brief:
Israeli state broadcaster Kan and its radio station Reshet Bet have revealed new information contradicting Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's account of events on the morning of October 7, 2023, the Shehab Wire reported. Netanyahu had previously claimed he was not awakened that morning, a statement the broadcaster's findings now dispute with newly disclosed details about his whereabouts and activities.

The contradiction marks the latest challenge to Netanyahu's public narrative surrounding the October 7 attacks. The broadcaster's investigation has produced evidence that conflicts with the prime minister's assertion, though the specific nature of the new information remained unclear from available reports.

title: Israeli state broadcaster challenges Netanyahu's October 7 account
